papers.title: Erosion-resistance mechanisms of biopolymer-vegetation reinforced slopes under rainfall using experimental and coupled CFD-DEM methods

papers.title: Enhancing landslide displacement prediction by integrating geological conditions into an interpretable spatiotemporal deep learning model
papers.journal: Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering
papers.authors: Li Y, Hu X et al.
papers.angle: Adds geological context to a deep learning landslide predictor, giving practitioners a more interpretable tool for forecasting slope displacement and prioritising monitoring.

papers.title: Large-Scale Triaxial Testing on Suffusion Characteristics and Permeability Evolution of Gap-Graded Soils under Different Controlling Constriction Sizes
papers.journal: Journal of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Engineering
papers.authors: Fu Y, Zou D et al.
papers.angle: Provides quantitative guidance on choosing leakage opening sizes for suffusion tests, helping engineers judge internal erosion risk in gap-graded fills and filters.

papers.title: Compaction of Fine-Grained soils under low water conditions: Experimental insights and performance improvement
papers.authors: Hocini Y, Medjnoun A et al.
papers.angle: Shows how compaction of fine soils at low water content can be improved, offering earthworks practitioners practical ways to meet specifications in dry conditions.

papers.title: Digital monitoring of continuous outer-casing drilling and inner core-barrel sampling for profiling Shanghai soils
papers.journal: Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering
papers.authors: Wu S, Liang Z et al.
papers.angle: Digital recording of drilling and sampling parameters offers a richer, more objective soil profile for Shanghai projects than traditional logs.

papers.title: Dissolution-disintegration characteristics and microstructural evolution of improved fully weathered red-bed mudstone under drying-wetting cycles
papers.journal: Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering
papers.authors: Yu C, Zhou S et al.
papers.angle: Shows how an improved weathered mudstone degrades under wetting and drying, guiding engineers using treated red-bed soils in embankments and cut slopes.

papers.title: Reservoir-Piezometric Water Level Relationship: Analytical-Numerical Modeling with Field Observations
papers.angle: Clarifies what piezometer readings against reservoir level really mean, helping dam engineers interpret monitoring data and spot genuine changes in performance.

papers.title: Non-destructive prediction of bio-healed rock fracture strength using full-scale mechanical testing
papers.journal: Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering
papers.authors: Dai Q, Pan X et al.
papers.angle: Offers a non-destructive way to estimate strength of bio-treated rock at full scale, a useful route for verifying biogrouting ground improvement in the field.

papers.title: Can advanced sand-based models predict the behaviour of silty sands? A comprehensive experimental and numerical assessment
papers.authors: Tafili M, Duque J et al.
papers.angle: Tests whether advanced sand models can handle silty sands, giving practitioners a sense of when these constitutive models are reliable for seismic analysis.

papers.authors: Yan F, Li G et al.
papers.angle: Probabilistic, spatially mapped risk of rock instability in deep mines offers a practical framework for prioritising ground support and monitoring.

papers.title: Study on a triaxial damage constitutive model for rock considering freeze–thaw and load effects

papers.authors: Zhang Z, Zhu S et al.
papers.angle: A damage model accounting for freeze–thaw and loading can support design of rock slopes and tunnels in cold regions, though calibration to site data is needed.
